$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for naturalearth/country_names, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the `pattern` on iso_a3, the shape country_names.overrides.json publishes, and a `minLength`/`maxLength` envelope on name_key, loose since a key can be a name in any of Natural Earth's languages. NOT ENFORCED, by design: NULLs (invisible to ft_validate), uniqueness, and object-level `required` (documentation only). Derived from build/stage/country_names.parquet on Natural Earth's release 5.1.1.
title: naturalearth/country_names
